newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle Tuesday roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle Tuesday roundup - USDA.

text.p: DODGE CITY, July 9 (Reuder) - Trade was rather slow on Tuesday, with slaughter steers and heifers steady to $1.00 per cwt lower, USDA said.
Confirmed - 14,300 last week - 54,100 last year - none
Wk to date- 73,500 last week - 70,700 last year - 10,600

Slaughter steers - few Select and Choice 2-3 1175-1250 lbs 61.00-62.00; pen Select with end Choice 1225 lbs 61.50; pen Select and Choice 1250- 1300 lb Holsteins 55.00. Dressed basis Select and Choice 1175-1200 lbs 98.00.

Slaughter heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 980-1100 lbs 61.00-62.00, couple pens 980-1000 lbs 61.00; few Select with end Choice 950-960 lbs 60.00. Dressed basis Select and Choice 2-3 1075-1150 lbs 98.00-101.00 hot weights delivered.
Inquiry was moderate and demand light. Sales confirmed on 6,900 slaughter steers and 7,400 slaughter heifers Tuesday.
For the week to date 73,500 head confirmed including 17,500 head or about 24 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
